mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artworks WHERE id = #{artworkId} AND is_active = 1

SELECT a.id, a.image_url, a.title, ar.name AS artist_name, a.price, a.medium, a.badge FROM wishlist_items wi JOIN artworks a ON wi.artwork_id = a.id JOIN artists ar ON a.artist_id = ar.id WHERE wi.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_active = 1 ORDER BY wi.created_at DESC
